CutScene.Text: The Dwarves of Khaz-Agar were defeated, and their gold was taken back to Kelthurax the Dragon.
Kelthurax was pleased – his smile showed row upon of row of needle-sharp teeth. When he had heaped this new treasure upon his hoard, he spoke once more:
“Very well… you wish to know of the Sundering? Then I shall tell you.”
“Prince Mordaine was a fool to attempt the spell. It cannot be cast. Such power was not meant for mortals to wield.”

“As for how to stop it…Well… after the Sundering, 3000 years past, the Elven Queen Ehlanna created a counter-spell. Ehlanna died long ago, and I believe the spell too is lost – locked away somewhere in the Citadel of Ice on the northern Tundra.”
